mootLines.line:
Travel 1 tile to meadow.
— Open ground —
The grass is bent in a long smooth run, like something heavy slid through it. You walk the other way around.
★ IDENTIFIED: Wild Ramps. Broad smooth leaves, onion smell. Spring only. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
◈ THE TRIAL — the audience is restless. The System offers Erin a trial, broadcast live. Survive it and take the slot. Refuse it and... well. The audience remembers refusals. (Ability slots: 4)
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "A trial, broadcast live. The audience loves a trial." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
◈ TRIAL COMPLETE — the audience applauds, which sounds like static. (+15 integration, gift: a lesson: Brawler's Instinct) Quiet luck was with you.

◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
📺 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "We have designed a trial JUST for you. Based on our observations. Which are extensive. And flattering."
1. Trial of Stone — Endure. That is the whole trial. Endure.
2. Trial of the Long Stalk — Take game with patience, not noise.
3. Trial of the Perfect Meal — Cook something worth remembering.
Each trial takes a FULL day-part and leaves you drained (−250 kcal). Pick one. The System waits — it has already run the simulations, and it is terrible at keeping secrets.
📺 TRIAL ACCEPTED: Trial of Stone. "Excellent choice. We simulated all three. This one had the best lighting."
(A day-part, gone to the trial. −250 kcal. Your hands are shaking. The fans loved it.)
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.

💛 You hold Lucky Coin. Worn smooth. {kin} flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until to
It's Devon who says it first. "Murder. There — said plain — don't look away, any of you." Heads turn. 2 days until the moot. Use them.
📓 Codex: Accused of murder by Devon. Moot in 2 days.
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
They're named, every one: Mei Calhoun, Nadia Cohen. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
◈ TRIAL COMPLETE — the audience applauds, which sounds like static. (+15 integration, gift: a lesson: Draw Fire) Quiet luck was with you.
Devon calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
Devon is on their feet before the talk dies down. "Raising hands against one of us. Said plain, in front of everyone." Heads turn. 3 days until the moot. Use them.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Mei nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
Devon calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.

◈ TRIAL COMPLETE — the audience applauds, which sounds like static. (+15 integration, gift: a lesson: Scarecrow) Quiet luck was with you.

They're named, every one: Tariq Adeyemi. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Tariq nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
Valeria stands up at the fire, pointing. "This one. Murder. There — said plain — and we all know it." Heads turn. 3 days until the moot. Use them.
Arturo is gone — the moot doesn't try the dead. The case dies with the accused; the fire remembers the rest.
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
It's Valeria who says it first. "Murder. There — said plain — don't look away, any of you." Heads turn. 2 days until the moot. Use them.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
Valeria calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The oldest among them stands. The fire seems to lean in. "You — take what you can carry and go."
◈ CRISIS — THE SCHISM. You are cast out. The village chose, and the choosing cut something that won’t heal clean. The fire keeps burning without you.
Exiled. You leave with what you carry — nothing more. Behind you, Haven keeps its fire. Ahead: the world, which just got much bigger.
📓 Codex: Exiled (moot). Walking.
The pantry is closed to you. The book stays behind. To Haven, you are not one of ours anymore. Membership asked nothing — no presence, no check-ins. Exile is the one way to lose it.
The pantry is not yours anymore. Exile means exile — membership had no check-ins, but it had exactly one way to lose it.
Reason: defied exile. You did this.
